title: Contract Term, Pause and Termination Schedule for the Office Pantry & Beverage Program
content:
The standard term of an Office Pantry & Beverage Program agreement, the notice that ends it, the charge for ending it early, and the figures that govern a pause in standing deliveries are printed against each tier.

## Term and termination

| Tier | Standard initial term of the agreement (whole months) | Written notice required to end the agreement (calendar days) | Charge for ending the agreement before the end of the term (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 12 | 30 | 370.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 12 | 30 | 930.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 24 | 60 | 2360.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 24 | 90 | 4900.00 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 36 | 90 | 8360.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 36 | 120 | 17900.00 |

## Pausing and restarting standing deliveries

| Tier | Shortest delivery pause the tier accepts (calendar days) | Ceiling on paused calendar days in one contract year | Monthly charge while deliveries stand paused (USD) | Notice to restart standing deliveries (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 7 | 30 | 45.00 | 3 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 7 | 30 | 95.00 | 5 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 10 | 45 | 240.00 | 7 |
| Barista Bar Program | 14 | 45 | 490.00 | 10 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 14 | 60 | 835.00 | 14 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 21 | 60 | 1790.00 | 21 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The term is the standard initial term of the agreement, in whole months. The notice figure is the written notice required to end the agreement, in calendar days. The early charge is the charge for ending the agreement before the end of the term.
- The shortest pause is the shortest delivery pause the tier accepts, in calendar days, and the annual figure is the ceiling on paused calendar days in one contract year.
- The standby figure is the monthly charge while deliveries stand paused. The restart figure is the notice needed to restart standing deliveries, in calendar days.

Terms and notice periods do not move in step: Fresh Pantry Program and Barista Bar Program share a 24 month term while carrying 60 and 90 calendar days of notice respectively.
